From latest post:

Genuinely the cutest fucking thing I've ever drawn in my dingdang life.I hope you've enjoyed the conclusion of Rut & Ritual! Honestly, this comic was a really fun breath of fresh air for me after doing a lot of plot-heavy comics, and I was delighted to hear on stream that a lot of you have been enjoying this porny/sweet sidebar. Though the next comic will have more plot than this, I am aiming to keep following this direction, both because it's more fun for me to draw, and because you guys seem to appreciate it! So next month get ready for a new adventure, and thanks for joining me on this one!
